{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "focal",
      "toKey": "n-14v88js",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm AL-44 triggered at the receiving header (P-R) because a command or observation of low pressure occurred. The evidence distinguishes that an alarm display text ('COMP FAULT') is not proof of compressor failure but maps to P-R per PR-12, supporting the link between the event and the condition.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["incident-description", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the alarm had not triggered, work would have continued; however, this does not explain why pressure dropped.",
      "competingExplanation": "The interruption could be at the source or distribution system rather than a local valve state change.","evidenceGap":"No record identifies whether the drop originated upstream (source) or downstream of P-R. The directory explicitly states it cannot establish valve positions or supply availability at any given time, leaving the physical mechanism unknown."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-14v88js",
      "toKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The alarm triggered at P-R (RHOB) while the crew was preparing in the 1SC gallery. The directory confirms these are separate operating locations, meaning a supply disturbance affecting RHOB does not automatically imply local valve failure.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the locations were not separate, a local valve failure in 1SC would directly affect RHOB; however, they are confirmed as distinct.",
      "competingExplanation":"The interruption could be upstream of both locations (e.g., site header H-U).","evidenceGap":"No record identifies whether P-R pressure dropped due to an upstream supply loss or a local valve state change."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-gc2yt8",
      "toKey": "n-z74g2j",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The work was paused because the maintenance boundary had not been released. The directory states that a scheduled work order does not equate to release, and acceptance signatures were pending.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual":"If the boundary had been released, work could have continued despite low pressure; however, release was pending.",
      "competingExplanation":"The pause might also be due to procedural caution rather than a formal barrier failure.","evidenceGap":"No record confirms whether Utilities and RHOB communicated about the alarm or coordinated response steps."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The focal event (alarm at P-R) is supported by evidence mapping AL-44 to low pressure below 4.5 bar. The interruption's origin remains unknown due to lack of valve-state records and inability to distinguish source vs distribution failure. Separate operating locations confirm that a local issue in one area does not explain the other, but upstream supply loss cannot be ruled out.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["incident-description", "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1", "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Point of interruption (source vs distribution)", "Valve states at any time", "Communication between Utilities and RHOB regarding alarm response"],
    "alternatives": [
      "Upstream supply loss affecting both locations",
      "Local valve failure in 1SC gallery not reflected in P-R reading due to routing change"
    ],
    "confidence": 0.75
  },"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-req-001","sourceId:eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1,claimRef:n-gkf844",
    "question\":\"Was there an engineering disposition or temporary instruction attached for changes to instrument-air service affecting RHOB between 2024-03-01 and May 20, 2024?\""
  ]}
